what: Molson Coors brews beer: Coors Light, Miller Lite, Blue Moon, Carling and Staropramen, sold across North America and Europe, and it has been adding non-beer drinks.
customers: Beer drinkers through supermarkets, off-licences, bars and restaurants.
money: Coors Light, Miller Lite and Blue Moon in the United States and Canada
Carling, Staropramen and other European brands
moat: Two of America's three best-selling beers and the distribution agreements that keep them on tap and on shelf, which a new brand cannot buy its way into.
risks: American beer volumes decline every year as drinkers move to spirits, seltzers and nothing at all
The 2023 share gains from a competitor's boycott have partly reversed
opportunities: 8.7 times earnings and 6.3 times free cash flow with $1.2B of free cash flow
The company buys back stock heavily and has raised the dividend
Analysts see about 6% upside, and cost savings have held the margin despite falling volumes
watch: American beer volume trends and whether the share gains hold.
